description: Defines the TaskItem class and TaskStatus enum for task management within the task-flow API, including properties for task details and references to user assignments.

classes.name: TaskItem
classes.description: Represents a task item with properties for ID, title, description, status, due date, assigned user, creation, and update timestamps.

methods.name: TaskStatus
methods.description: Enumeration defining possible statuses for a task, including Todo, InProgress, Done, and Blocked.
